scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New feature block: Learned feature interactions via factorization machine or neural interaction layer, replacing manual cross-terms.

H50_LEARNED_INTERACTIONS.question: Do learned feature interactions (factorization machine style) improve fold-0 OOF AUC when added to the rich view?
H50_LEARNED_INTERACTIONS.method: Add a factorization machine interaction layer (rank 8) on top of the 285-feature rich view. Cross-fit 5-fold: train FM interaction layer on folds 1-4, predict interaction features for fold-0. LGBM on rich + FM features vs rich alone.
H50_LEARNED_INTERACTIONS.leakage: FM trained on FIT only (folds 1-4), interaction features predicted for fold-0. Fold-safe.
H50_LEARNED_INTERACTIONS.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
